top_signals.title: Transforming the New York Liberty Into WNBA Champions
top_signals.summary: Clara Wu Tsai sits down with David Rubenstein to discuss New York Liberty's transformation. She talks about moving the team from Westchester to the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, investing in players, facilities and management, and how it all led to winning the WNBA championship. Wu Tsai joins David Rubenstein for the premiere episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations, Season 12. This interview was recorded June 4, in Brooklyn, New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Exclusive: EuroLeague CEO ‘open’ to NBA investment talks but yet to receive an offer
top_signals.summary: EuroLeague Basketball chiefs are expecting a takeover approach from the NBA that would see the two organisations collaborate on a new European basketball league. CEO Chus Bueno said no offer had yet been put to the EuroLeague but NBA commissioner Adam Silver this week said that joining forces with the incumbent was now their preference. [...]
